audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup-defining interaction was never stated anywhere on the page: Unraveled Earth only stuns enemies who DASH through it or are KNOCKED through it. Aurora's W and R are both dashes, so her escape button is the thing that detonates the stun, and Seismic Shove exists to throw her into the minefield. The page instead invented 'stacked W charges' for Taliyah, which is not in her kit at all.
audit.why: Riot's text: E 'creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.' W 'throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.' There is no charge mechanic on Seismic Shove; the only stacking resource in the kit is Worked Ground created by Threaded Volley.
audit.corrected: tradeBad, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d, report[5].t, enemyWin, phases[2].why and the content early/whys now say plainly: trade on foot, never dash out through her mines, and every 'W charges' claim is removed.

notes: Both packet suspectNames entries are false positives — 'Your Between Worlds' and 'Use Weaver's Wall' are the correct names. The kit's derived flags put 'grounding' on Threaded Volley and Seismic Shove, but Riot's own descriptions of both abilities say nothing about grounding, so per the brief's rule I trusted the description and asserted nothing about grounding anywhere. Weaver's Wall creates terrain, so it can in principle block or reroute Aurora's dashes, but Riot's text ('creates a very long wall and then surfs it') does not say how it interacts with a dash mid-flight and I had no source, so I left that out rather than guess. Content whys[5]/spikes[2] recommend Riftmaker/Shadowflame while report[8] recommends Luden's into Sorcerer's — the same build disagreement as the rest of this champion's pages; left alone, no source to decide.
